title: Chaitanya Nursing School
description: A professional web presence for CNSG Nursing College — from zero online presence to a live, enrollment-driving site.
challenge: CNSG had no website and was losing prospective students to competitor nursing programs that had polished online presences. They needed something fast, professional, and easy to update.
solution: Built a clean, fast marketing site with program information, faculty profiles, application process, and a contact/inquiry form. SEO-optimized and deployed to Vercel in under 3 weeks.
